dashboard.label: BigFix Root Server (BESRelay) Health
dashboard.description: Core health monitoring for Database Connectivity, HTTP Gather operations, Site Entitlements, and Service Uptime

search.query: index=bigfix sourcetype="bigfix:root:besrelay" | head 1 | eval Status=if(match(_raw, "(?i)stopping|shutting down"), "DOWN", "UP") | table Status
index=bigfix sourcetype="bigfix:root:besrelay" ("Database Error" OR "HTTP Error" OR "GetURL failure" OR "Unable to find site id" OR "entitlement expired") | stats count

drilldown.link: search?q=index=bigfix sourcetype="bigfix:root:besrelay" ("Database Error" OR "HTTP Error" OR "GetURL failure" OR "Unable to find site id" OR "entitlement expired")&earliest=$earliest$&latest=$latest$

search.query: index=bigfix sourcetype="bigfix:root:besrelay" ("Database Error" OR "HTTP Error" OR "GetURL failure" OR "Unable to find site id" OR "entitlement expired") | eval Error_Category=case( match(_raw, "Database Error"), "Database / SQL", match(_raw, "HTTP Error|GetURL failure"), "HTTP / Network Timeouts", match(_raw, "Unable to find site id"), "Missing Custom Site IDs", match(_raw, "entitlement expired"), "Site Entitlement Expired", true(), "Other") | timechart count by Error_Category

index=bigfix sourcetype="bigfix:root:besrelay" "Database Error:" | rex field=_raw "\s-\s(?<Thread_or_Process>[^\-]+)\s-\s(?<Error_Message>.*Database Error:.*)" | table _time, Thread_or_Process, Error_Message | sort - _time

index=bigfix sourcetype="bigfix:root:besrelay" ("HTTP Error" OR "GetURL failure") | rex field=_raw "\s-\s(?<Thread_or_Process>[^\-]+)\s-\s(?<Error_Message>.*(?:HTTP Error|GetURL).*)" | table _time, Thread_or_Process, Error_Message | sort - _time

index=bigfix sourcetype="bigfix:root:besrelay" "find site id" | search _raw="*Unable to find site id*" | rex field=_raw "(?<Error_Message>Unable to find site id.*)" | table _time, Error_Message | sort - _time
